The Enforcement Directorate conducted a raid on the home of an aide to senior Congress leader Harish Rawat, seizing gold items and several luxury watches.

Following the seizure, Rawat said he would step down from his Congress posts, stressing that he is not leaving the party, which he described as his "blood and bones," and added that he does not want the party to suffer.
